name: OmO
author: tmdgusya
license: Mixed: MIT code; Sustainable Use License 1.0 for OmO-derived cat assets (see LICENSE)
description: A compact OmO cat for the Omarchy bar. It runs only while a senpi session is verifiably working, glows during a live ultrawork loop, and opens a native panel of sessions with truthful todo and verified-criteria counts.

barWidget.description: Cat cell plus active session count; click for the session panel (View, Launch, keyboard navigation).

schema.label: senpi executable
schema.description: Absolute senpi executable path for Launch when senpi is not on the desktop shell PATH.

schema.label: OmO launcher
schema.description: Absolute path to omo (preferred) or senpi used by Open and Launch. Empty falls back to senpiPath. Set by the installer.

schema.label: Live tracking registered globally
schema.description: Set by install-plugin.sh --track-all-sessions. When true, Open/Launch do not pass the status extension explicitly.

schema.label: Session notifications
schema.description: Send native Omarchy cards for verified waiting, completion, and error transitions.

schema.label: Storm border
schema.description: Temporarily charge the active window border during verified ultrawork.

schema.label: Storm wallpaper overlay
schema.description: Opt in to the animated wallpaper storm overlay.

schema.label: Poll interval while sessions are active (ms)
Poll interval with no active session (ms)
Reduce motion
schema.description: Still faces and a steady glow instead of the running cycle, blink, and bolt.

schema.label: Agent directory override
schema.description: Passed to the collector as --agent-dir. Empty means ~/.omo/agent; point it at a fixture root for QA.

schema.label: Task registry override
schema.description: Passed to the collector as --task-dir. Empty means ~/.omo/senpi-task.
